scope: All 142 residual whole-token mnogih forms: one in book 44 and 141 in the base papers.
choice: Normalize every genitive/locative plural form mnogih to official mnogyh.
motivation: The official g-final hard-stem adjective mnogy takes the regular plural oblique ending -yh; every occurrence was sentence-inspected.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining -ih preserves a mixed national declension.
Changing other mnogy paradigm members was unnecessary and outside the exact agreement defect.

evidence.semantic_review: All 142 sites modify genitive/locative plural nouns or substantivized plurals. No comments, foreign arguments, control names or valid holds occur.
